subject: Operations
title: Managing Global Teams
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Managing Global Teams.

hook.text: A team spans San Francisco, Berlin, and Bangalore. When California wakes up, India is going to bed. Coordination is key.

buildup.text: Global teams offer diverse perspectives but face challenges: time zones, languages, and different work norms.

discovery.text: Effective global teams establish shared rituals, overlapping hours, and documentation-first communication.

twist.text: Trust is harder to build remotely and across cultures. Without it, misunderstandings escalate into conflict fast.

climax.text: Companies that invest in periodic in-person meetups for global teams report 30% higher collaboration scores.

punchline.text: Global teams need global effort—in time, trust, and tools.

quiz.question: What helps global teams build trust?
options: Working only in one time zone
